levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: The three versions are nearly identical apart from the greeting.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: The three versions show clear differences in wording and formality.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: The three versions show clear, escalating formality and each reads as genuinely natural for that audience.

levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: The three versions ask for different things, not the same underlying request.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: All three versions ask for the same underlying thing.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: All three versions ask for the same thing and remain equally clear despite the register change.

levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: Names changes vaguely ('it's more formal') without specific wording examples.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Names at least three specific wording or structural changes.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: Names specific changes and explains why each fits its audience, not just that it differs.

lookFors: The supervisor version is clearly usable in a real workplace context; the friend version clearly is not.
Each of the three versions is understandable on its own without needing the others for context.
The reflection identifies a genuine reason one version was harder, not a restatement of the task.

nonDiagnosticGuard: Do not infer effort, motivation, diagnosis, or character from an error.
